about: The owner's photo library (2026-10): the photos curated for the site, re-encoded to at most 2400 px (no metadata). upload.mjs uploads each file; registry.mjs writes web/src/lib/library-photos.json from this list and assets.json. `faces` are head boxes (x0,y0,x1,y1 as fractions of the photo), each checked by eye on the photo; `heroCrop` frames a city hero so the heads start at 71.5% of the frame, under the open sky the words sit on. No alt names a place: where a photo was taken is not known.
